mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate decline exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals tightening labor market conditions that accelerate inflation expectations, triggering Fed policy tightening and negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE declines exceed 0.3pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts decline exceeding 2% and retail sales growth exceeding 1% indicate weakening consumer demand not offset by spending strength, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing supply shock (INDPRO decline > 1.5% from prior month) during an economic expansion reduces corporate output capacity and profit margins, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of INDPRO decline >1.5% periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 2.0% signals persistent inflation that forces the Fed to accelerate rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of CPIAUCSL >2.0 instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly payroll growth exceeding 100k persons consistently supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of PAYEMS >100k periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 650 thousand units signal deteriorating residential construction, reducing household wealth and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of HOUST <650 instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent industrial production decline exceeding 1.5% and unemployment rate rise exceeding 0.2 percentage points indicate simultaneous supply constraints and labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
